race.comment: FILTHY (1) deserves another chance after a long neck second at the Gold Coast as favourite, and his previous fourth at Ipswich was also good after he picked up nicely late. He is race fit, proven on wet ground and Maloney's adds further confidence. Looks the to beat. PRIZE WITNESS (11) resumes and makes her stable debut for the Bruce yard. Showed encouraging signs in her two preps and looks to have come back in good touch, stripping fitter for a neat recent trial win. Draws well and can play a major role. MARTINDALE KID (6) was strong through the line when second at the Sunny Coast and has enough upside second-up to give this a big shake. KING'S ANCHOR (5) returns and makes his stable debut for the Thornton camp. Showed positive signs in Vic and his recent trial suggests he's come back in good order. Thompson's booking is always a good push, so keeping in mind.
